'''Gustab Wenbus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] who lived circa [[100 BBY/Legends|100 BBY]]. He was recognized as the developer of the incarnation of [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] popular around the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. While his prototype [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] pod was created by a [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] named [[Phoebos/Legends|Phoebos]], Wenbus entered a race as the pod's [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and was remembered by history as the being to standardize the Podracer's configuration.<ref name="EV" />
